verdict.rationale: Only community reports support this story: one user runs Ollama on an AMD RX 6650 and notes ROCm containers shipped since 0.1.27, and another describes native MLX on Apple silicon. A separate report shows ROCm detection failing and falling back to CPU. That is a configuration failure, not a contradiction of a documented claim. missing for 10: first-party documentation of GPU vendor support, any evidence of NVIDIA/CUDA acceleration, documented AMD ROCm compatibility requirements, independent benchmarks across GPU vendors.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models on NVIDIA, AMD, or other GPU vendors using vendor-specific acceleration kernels

citations.quote: I have been running Ollama on my AMD RX 6650 for weeks. They have shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27.
native mlx should mean better memory handling on apple silicon.
